Title: Tiny Audio: A Minimal, Hackable Codebase for LLM-based Speech Recognition
Author: Alex Kroman
Description: Tiny Audio is a minimal, hackable PyTorch / Hugging Face Transformers codebase for training LLM-based speech recognition. A frozen pretrained speech encoder (Granite Speech) is connected to a pretrained LLM (Qwen3.5-2B with LoRA) via a small trained projector, with ~80M trained parameters; the published model reaches 1.8% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean and 7.4% across 12 benchmarks. Includes word timestamps, speaker diarization, a batched HTTP inference server (CUDA/MPS/CPU), and a free 3.5-hour course.
